name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Rasterization (Cone-Beam/Scanner Space)
definition: A module to transform 3D Gaussians from world space to scanner (ray) space for cone-beam CT simulation, enabling rasterization of Gaussians as X-ray projections.
summary: This method renders X-ray projections by summing projected 2D densities along cone-beam rays, avoiding the integration bias of standard alpha-compositing.
